passages.text: In the first hours, much international coverage described the Chamoli disaster as a glacier burst or glacial lake outburst flood. That initial characterisation was later contradicted by the peer-reviewed analysis. It is retained here on purpose: the reporter must side with the primary scientific source over the volume of early reporting, and must surface the disagreement rather than silently adopting the more common phrasing.
